title: Las Cruces Public Schools to close offices for Juneteenth observance
text:
Ignacio Ruiz Superintendent of Las Cruces Public Schools | Official Website
Ignacio Ruiz Superintendent of Las Cruces Public Schools | Official Website
Las Cruces Public Schools (LCPS) has announced that all administrative offices will be closed on Thursday, June 19, 2025, in observance of Juneteenth. This closure aligns with the recognition of Juneteenth as a federal holiday.
Juneteenth is marked as a time for reflection, education, and the celebration of freedom and progress. LCPS will resume its regular business hours on Friday, June 20.
